original_card.question: Can one uncovered interface implication be formalized with exact caller and certificate bindings?
methods: Formalize a missing boundary lemma identified by the selected review.
Audit a formal theorem-to-certificate binding independently.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State the exact formalized proposition and remaining assumptions; avoid duplicate arithmetic formalizations already present.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one missing statement with quantified hypotheses, actual caller and existing coverage. A compact-switch lemma is a candidate only after its mathematical contract is reviewed. Establish a bounded proof plan before a separately budgeted proof-assistant build; do not rerun large Lean jobs as orientation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one formal lemma or one theorem-to-certificate binding.
scope_change_triggers: Formalizing already-covered arithmetic and claiming the full multiplication theorem.

existing_checks.remaining: Exact theorem-to-caller binding and genuinely uncovered interface lemmas.
Uniform algorithmic implications, not another endpoint digit.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: compact-switch formalization proposed as future validation.
existing_checks.remaining: Audit the statement and assumptions before a formal proof campaign.

actual_scope: Compute the actual 112-generator doubled Bell group of order 2^44, sharpen the already known uniform degree bound from 2^93 to 2^47, and prove that the minimal polynomial is constant from width 10 on. The exact width-two polynomial and stable degree remain undetermined.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a formal caller binding. This is a written finite-group side result on the operator in Krzysztof Wojt PR5168. Merged PR6302 already proves uniform existence and qualitative eventual stabilization. The new scope is its quantitative sharpening by an independently derived exact group-order calculation and a trace-value argument; no Lean binding is added.
bottleneck_link: Side result. It sharpens the known uniform degree bound and gives a finite width by which the scalar-polynomial decoder algebra reaches its stable spectrum. It prices no decoder, no source access and no restoration, and it does not change kappa.
stop_rule: Stop at a proved universal annihilator, monotone degree and explicit stabilization width, or at a precise gap; do not search for the width-two polynomial.
evidence: PROOF.md (written proof; Burnside-Brauer cited). verify.py (standard library): source binding, Bell identity on all 112 labels, d_A = 36, d_K = 8, |G| = 2^44, two exactly enumerated groups, four rejecting controls. Outcome: scoped written proof with a finite certificate; no kappa, no supplier admission, no selected-frontier change.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Which irreducibles of G occur in V tensor V through V tensor(9), and what are d_2, ..., d_9?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the finite form of the unequal outer-label classification left open by equal-bell-two-slot-spectrum and fixes the exact width-two polynomial.
open_questions.first_step: Use the normal series K (dimension 8) by A (dimension 36), compute the A-orbits on the 256 characters of K and the stabilizers.
open_questions.blocked_by: Projective irreducibles over the stabilizers can be large and each needs the exact spectrum of an operator of size 8 dim(pi).

open_questions.question: Can the stabilization width 10 be lowered?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A smaller width leaves fewer intermediate degrees d_2, ..., d_9 to determine.
open_questions.first_step: Find which ranks of M_S = sum of q q^T occur in the 36-dimensional span and which trace values 2^(18-r) occur on G.
open_questions.blocked_by: The span has 2^36 elements, so an orbit or invariant argument is needed instead of enumeration.

open_questions.question: Can deg mu be bounded far below 2^47, or the lower bound 1093 raised?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The present uniform bound only shows finiteness; a useful value would price the best scalar-polynomial decoder at every width.
open_questions.first_step: Build one small irreducible of G from a character of K with a large stabilizer and compute the exact spectrum of its x_pi.
open_questions.blocked_by: The dimension of pi and the cost of an exact characteristic polynomial.

overlap_checkpoint.delta: Exact actual-group order, degree at most 2^47, and stabilization by width ten. Uniform existence and qualitative stabilization were already known.
